payload.prompt: Gjer forenkla årsoppgjer for 2025: 1) Rekn ut og bokfør årlege avskrivingar for tre eigedelar: Programvare (364700 kr, 4 år lineært, konto 1250), IT-utstyr (313300 kr, 8 år, konto 1210), Inventar (270900 kr, 6 år, konto 1240). Bruk konto 6010 for avskrivingskostnad og 1209 for akkumulerte avskrivingar. 2) Reverser forskotsbetalt kostnad (totalt 20500 kr på konto 1700). 3) Rekn ut og bokfør skattekostnad (22 % av skattbart resultat) på konto 8700/2920. payload.goal: Gjere forenkla årsoppgjer for 2025 med eigne bilag for årlege avskrivingar, reversering av forskotsbetalt kostnad og bokføring av skattekostnad.
success_checks: Tre separate bilag er oppretta for avskrivingar i 2025
Avskriving programvare er bokført med 91175 på 6010 mot 1209
Avskriving IT-utstyr er bokført med 39162.5 på 6010 mot 1209
Avskriving inventar er bokført med 45150 på 6010 mot 1209
Forskotsbetalt kostnad på 1700 er reversert med totalt 20500 i 2025
Skattekostnad er bokført på 8700 mot 2920 med 22 % av skattbart resultat
Alle bilag har dato i 2025 og balanserer
risk_notes: Skattbart resultat er ikkje oppgitt; skattekostnad kan ikkje reknast endeleg utan dette talet
Reversering av forskotsbetalt kostnad manglar motkonto; må avklarast eller hentast frå opphavleg periodisering
Bruk av same akkumulerte avskrivingskonto 1209 for fleire eigedelstypar kan vere uvanleg; bør stadfestast mot kontoplan
Avskrivingane gir desimalbeløp for IT-utstyr; avrundingsregel må avklarast før bokføring dersom systemet krev heile øre
Det er ikkje oppgitt eksakt bilagsdato; vanleg val er 2025-12-31
payload.suggested_first_action: Hent eller avklar skattbart resultat for 2025 og motkonto for reversering av forskotsbetalt kostnad før bilag blir oppretta.
ordered_steps: Validate that fiscal year 2025 is open for posting and required ledger accounts exist: 1210, 1240, 1250, 1209, 1700, 6010, 8700, 2920
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 for software depreciation: debit 6010 91175, credit 1209 91175; include reference to asset account 1250 in description
Compute annual depreciation for IT equipment: 313300 / 8 = 39162.5
POST separate voucher dated 2025-12-31 for IT equipment depreciation: debit 6010 39162.5, credit 1209 39162.5; include reference to asset account 1210 in description
POST separate voucher dated 2025-12-31 for inventory depreciation: debit 6010 45150, credit 1209 45150; include reference to asset account 1240 in description
Identify original prepaid expense posting or target expense account for account 1700 reversal
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 to reverse prepaid expense total 20500: credit 1700 20500 and debit identified expense account 20500
Fetch or calculate taxable profit for 2025 from ledger/trial balance
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 for tax expense: debit 8700 computed amount, credit 2920 computed amount
Verify each voucher balances and that three depreciation vouchers are separate

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.
For supplier costs: use vatType=3 (NOT id=1) with ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex detects the expense account and applies inngående MVA automatically.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': switch to vatType=3 with single debit posting, OR add both debit+credit with vatType=0.
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.

payload.headline: 5/7 checks passed; tax voucher skipped and prepaid reversal used wrong account
what_went_wrong: Tax cost voucher (8700/2920) was never posted — agent decided account 8700 didn't exist and skipped the step entirely, failing checks 6 and 7.
Prepaid cost reversal (check likely on account 1700 vs expense account) used account 6300 as the offsetting debit instead of the correct expense account specified in the task.
Three 422 errors on initial voucher POSTs because account IDs were sent as unresolved '$REF:account_XXXX' strings instead of numeric IDs — wasted 3 API calls.
Agent created account 1209 mid-run (extra POST /ledger/account) instead of resolving the ID correctly from the earlier GET responses, adding unnecessary complexity.
what_worked: Three depreciation vouchers (software 91175, IT-equipment 39162.5, inventory 45150) were successfully posted as separate bilags on 2025-12-31.
Account lookup loop correctly identified missing account 1209 and created it before retrying voucher posts.
what_to_try_next: Always post the tax voucher: compute taxable result from ledger balances, then POST debit 8700 / credit 2920; if account 8700 is missing, create it like 1209 was created.
Fix the prepaid reversal: debit the correct expense account (e.g. 6300 or as specified) and credit 1700 — verify the offsetting account matches what the scorer expects.
Resolve account IDs before building voucher payloads (store GET /ledger/account results in a map keyed by account number) to avoid the 3 wasted 422 calls on unresolved $REF strings.
unnecessary_calls: POST /ledger/voucher (x3 with '$REF:account_XXXX' strings) — these failed immediately and could be avoided by resolving IDs first
GET /ledger/account (repeated call after account creation to re-verify 1209) — redundant since POST returned the new ID directly
